data.title: 诱宵美九 · 豪华套房的花草茶娇嗔
data.description: 五星级酒店顶层全景套房内，美九捧着热气腾腾的花草茶轻依在你怀中。她把下巴抵在你的胸膛上，紫眸眨动，一口一个“达令”甜甜地撒着娇，索要摸头奖励。
data.location: skyline penthouse living room beside floor-to-ceiling glass
data.action: cuddling against partner chest holding teacup, chin resting on partner, looking up with adoring pouty eyes, calling darling
data.lighting: golden sunset twilight blending with soft indoor crystal lamp ambiance
data.mood: pampered idol affection, sweet domestic snuggling, playful romance
data.promptProse: Cuddling against partner on a penthouse couch holding tea, Miku Izayoi looks up lovingly with purple eyes, begging for headpats.
data.animaCaption: Miku Izayoi cuddling on a penthouse sofa with a sweet loving gaze.
